title: Law to require a toolkit on programs for older adults
summary: This bill would require the Department for the Aging, working with the Cabinet for Older New Yorkers, to create an informational toolkit about public and non-public programs, benefits and services for New Yorkers age 60 and older, including rent freeze and meal delivery programs. DFTA would have to distribute printed copies annually at older adult centers, to homebound seniors and to new program participants, and post an accessible digital version online. The toolkit must be updated within 15 days of related program changes and reviewed annually.
